attchmntText: Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication w.r.t. Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026

Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording  of the Earnings Conference Call held on Tuesday, November 03, 2026 at 17:30 hours (IST) pertaining to financial performance of the Company for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Sanyam Nagpal as Executive Director of the Company w.e.f. January 01, 2027.
Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Ms Meena Lall as Non- Executive Independent Director of the Company w.e.f. January 01, 2027.
Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation

Board of Director of Dreamfolks Services Limited has approved the proposal to provide security by way of fixed deposits of INR 5.5  crore each to ICICI Bank Limited and AU Small Finance Bank Limited, to secure the obligations of Ten 11 Hospitality Private Limited (formerly known as  Ten 11 Hospitality LLP ) ( Ten 11 ), subsidiary of the Company, in connection with overdraft facilities backed by Fixed Deposits to be availed by Ten 11, as per the facility documents.
desc: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party

attchmntText: Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding appointment of Ms. Meena Lall (DIN: 05133322) as an Additional Director of the Company and designated her as Independent Director of Company, w.e.f. January 01, 2027, to hold office for a term of three (3) consecutive years, commencing from the date of her appointment i.e. January 01, 2027  through December 31, 2029 (both days inclusive), not liable to retire by rotation, subject to the approval of the Shareholders and appointment of Mr. Sanyam Nagpal (DIN: 10074641) as an Additional Director and designated him as Executive Director of Company, w.e.f. January 01, 2027, to hold office for a term of five (5) consecutive years, commencing from the date of his appointment i.e. January 01, 2027 through December 31, 2031 (both days inclusive), liable to retire by rotation, on the terms and conditions of the said appointment, including but not limited to remuneration payable, subject to the approval of the Shareholders.

Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange that basis the recommendation of Audit Committee, the Board of Directors of the Company approved the appointment of TRC Corporate Consulting Private Limited as Internal Auditor of the Company for the Financial Year 2026-27.
Dreamfolks Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on Second Phase of Acquisition

Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI LODR Regulations, the schedule of the Earnings Conference Call for discussing the financial performance of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 is enclosed herewith.

Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has received favourable Order dated October 14, 2026 from the Office of the Commissioner of CGST & Central Excise (Appeals-II), Mumbai, 3rd Floor, CGST Bhavan, Plot No. C-24, Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai-400051 (Appellate Authority) setting aside the GST Demand Order from the Office of the Assistant Commissioner, Division -VI CGST & Central Excise, Mumbai East Commissionerate dated August 31, 2024 imposing the demand of Rs. 1,35,09,720 /- plus applicable interest plus penalty of Rs. 13,50,972/- under provisions of applicable GST Law(s).
desc: Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
